def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter,deque
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; res=[r[:] for r in grid]; inr=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j] or grid[i][j]==bg: continue
            c=grid[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and grid[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
            if len(comp)>=3:
                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1):
                    for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1):
                        res[y][x]=c; inr[y][x]=True
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not inr[i][j]: res[i][j]=bg
    return res
